cpsc_product_name: Little Bambino 4 in 1 canopy children's tricycles
incident_model: Octagonal 15 foot gazebo with sheet metal top
incident_product_description:
The product is an OutSunny brand 15 foot octagonal gazebo made of an aluminum structure and sheet metal canopy. It was purchased through Amazon.  

Fortunately, no one was injured during our attempt to assemble the product.  However, there are 32 sheet metal panels with sharp edges and sharp points that are supposed to slip into grooves on rail rafters and be held in place by 48 plastic shims. The instructions do not explain how to accomplish this and the panels continually slip out and fall.  

We developed an assembly procedure but realized that even if the canopy were fully assembled, the shims are very unlikely to hold the panels in their grooved rails when there are wind gusts or accumulated snow that will bow the panels and pull their edges out the grooves along with the little shims.  As projectiles, these panels would be very dangerous.

We returned the product.

cpsc_product_name: Little Bambino 4 in 1 canopy children's tricycles
incident_model: Mens multi lot # 45936, women's multi lot #45931
incident_product_description:
Health By Habit brand Men's multivitamin (Megamulti for Mega mileage) white bottle with gray.  60 count bottle.
And Health By Habit brand Women's multivitamin  (Supermulti for Super women) White bottle with pink. 60 count bottle.

The product is fine, but there is a warning label on the bottle that says Warning: Accidental Overdose of Iron-containing products is a leading cause of fatal poisoning in children under 6. Keep this product out of reach of children. In case of accidental overdose, call a doctor or poison control center immediately. 

I was shocked to read this, because the product is so easily opened. There is child safety precautions on other products that are much less dangerous. Why doesn't this one require it? 

To open, you simply turn the lid of the bottle and it reveals a little window where the product is dispensed. It's easy to spin, there is little resistance, and it's kind of fun to do.

cpsc_product_name: Just Blanks children's nightgowns
incident_product_description:
This product is not safe according to the Consumer Product Safety Commission. ASTM F 3342-19 Standard Guide for
Temporary Fence Applications for Construction Sites avoids defining what is safe when it comes to a fence that's designed to keep the public safe from construction sites, waterways, pools, or any other hazardous location. This is because the CPSC has decades of research defining what keeps our children safe from swimming pools. This agency has deep roots when it come to researching what is considered safe in fencing. There is also decades of caselaw that upholds the CPSC testing and regulation. In [REDACTED] three children jumped over a barrier that was non-CPSC compliant and one child drown in a lake. The rental company sued but in the end denied doing anything wrong and instead elected to settle out of court for a reported $20M. This is only one example of many that happen every day, and the problem just keeps getting worse because it's cheaper to pay off victims families than to increase the cost of the product to make it safe for the public. It's my hope that this agency will at minimum notify these companies that they are producing and marketing as product as a safety product when in reality the product is anything but.

incident_model: EMF&5G Blocker 4 pcs for Mobile Phones 2021 Latest
incident_product_description:
The product consists of a pack of four self-adhesive stickers. The stickers have a metallic gold appearance and are round, about the diameter of a quarter. They are printed with an image of an outline of a human body (in a sort of Vitruvian Man pose). The stickers arrive in packaging consisting of a printed cardstock backer with descriptions of their alleged benefits, and suggested use cases such as sticking to cell phones or appliances. This backer is then enclosed in a plastic wrap envelope, with four of the stickers and backers inside.
The supposed purpose of these products is to protect the user from harm that may allegedly be caused by electromagnetic radiation associated with the 5G cellular telephone network. The package copy includes such phrases as "Negative Ion+Far Infrared," "Caring for Health," and "Preventing Radiation."
Here are some more phrases from the product's listing on Amazon:
"About this item
    Absorb and transfer electromagnetic radiation waves by using special materials
    Reduce mobile phone radiation injury on the human brain of 99.99%
    Applicable for Mobile phone, Laptop, Microwave oven, TV set, Refrigerator, Hair dryer and other electric appliances"
(This supposed use case is dubious--it may be appropriate to call these items a scam, as there is no scientific basis for the statements the product makes, or for the alleged issues the products claim to address).

Stickers like this appear to be sold under a variety of "Generic" brands on Amazon and [REDACTED]. This is just one example of "anti-radiation stickers."

cpsc_product_name: All Field and Prism RGBA light fixtures
incident_product_description:
TRLIFE LED shop lights

Model TRLIFE 8-ft LED ceiling lights

As a hobbyist to build a workshop, I purchased 11/07/2021 from Amazon 6 TRLIFE 8-ft LED ceiling lights described as “8FT LED Light Fixtures 72W, 8FT LED Shop Light 6000K Cool White Dual Side T8 V-Shape Integrated 8 Foot LED Tube Lights(150W Fluorescent Light Equivalent), 8640Lm, Clear Cover (6 Pack)” sold and shipped by Talike with a Chinese address, 401-1 A Dong Shanyuehuagongyeyuan 63hao Xintangcun,Jutangshequ Fuchengjiedao Longhuaqu,Shenzhen,Guangdong,518110,CN
I wanted to wire the power connection from the middle instead of the end, I discovered that in spite of the instruction to connect a green wire to a ground, the internal wiring showed no ground connection to the metal casing at all.  The three-conductor terminal at the end is a sham with no ground fault protection, which is normally seen in all shop lights.  Since this is not a double insulated device, the metal casing without a ground wire protection is an unacceptable hazard.

Royal Gourmet Gas Grill

incident_product_description:
From Amazon:
Hamilton Beach 31103A Countertop Oven with Convection and Rotisserie, Metallic
Maximum versatility - including rotisserie
Extra-large capacity - fits two 12" pizzas, two 9" x 13" casseroles, or two cake pansThis oven is 110 voltage only It is packaged in SIOC packaging to avoid damage in shipping
Revolving rotisserie - meat self-bastes as it turns - fits a 5 lb chicken
Convection setting bakes faster and more evenly than traditional oven;Bake & broil settings with 2 hour timer1311 H x 2062 W x 1654 D
Durable stainless steel construction
Hamilton Beach Countertop Oven with Convection & Rotisserie 31103
Small enough to fit on your kitchen counter, but large enough to help you prepare for any meal or party, the Hamilton Beach Countertop Oven with Convection & Rotisserie boasts full-size oven performance in compact, energy-efficient form.Designed with both kitchen style and practicality in mind, the Countertop Oven with Convection & Rotisserie is portable and countertop convenient. It's packed with versatile cooking options that range from baking cakes to crisping cookies to broiling salmon to roasting an entire 5 lb. chicken, roast or pork. There's no need to spend extra time cooking separate meals for the pickier ones, either. The wide interior and adjustable cooking racks provide double the space for cooking multiple foods at once.What's more, this oven is ideal for anyone, anywhere and anytime. It can replace the microwave in your office, offer easy cooking access for the elderly, serve as a staple for apartment dwellers or provide snack enthusiasts with a little added treat.


PRODUCT FEATURE BENEFITS
Uses 49% less energy than a typical kitchen oven
Extra-large capacity accommodates two 12" pizzas, two 9"x13" casseroles, two cake pans, two sheets of cookies or a 5 lb. chicken
Easy-clean, nonstick oven interior
Includes two oven racks, large enamel-coated baking pan, small baking pan and broil rack
Broil rack also stacks directly on small baking pan for roasting meats
Includes rotisserie accessories: rotisserie lift and forks with rod (skewer) Slide-out, full-width crumb/drip tray
Easy-to-read temperature dial on front control panel can be adjusted to desired or pre-set temperatures
Easy-to-read function dial on front control panel can be adjusted to four pre-programmed settings: BAKE, CONVECTION, BROIL, ROTISSERIE
Power indicator light
2-hour cooking timer with audible tone and automatic shutoff

Gives You the Choice of Bake, Convection, Broil or Rotisserie
Don't want to heat up the entire kitchen or slave away over a hot burner? No sweat – the Hamilton Beach Countertop Oven provides extra capacity for second oven convenience as well as four ways to cook: BAKE, CONVECTION, BROIL and ROTISSERIE.

A 9"x13" baking pan can be found in most kitchens in North America, used for making everything from lasagna to brownies. Not only does this oven fit two 9"x13" pans at once, unlike conventional ovens without convection technology, the Countertop Oven with Convection and Rotisserie comes fully equipped. Instead of having heat come from just one central area and no fan to "stir-up" or circulate air evenly all over, this oven's convection technology utilizes a top and bottom heating element and a built-in fan to distribute heat evenly for a uniform temperature. incident_product_description:
LG LRMXC2206S French Door Refrigerator/Freezer  Stainless Steel,  Counter Depth     34-3/4" Wide, 31-1/4" Depth, and 69-3/4" High

We purchased an LG LRMXC2206S in April, 2022, and once installed, we placed digital thermometers in the fridge and also in the freezer to monitor the internal temps.  After a few days to equilibrate, the internal fridge temperatures recorded by the thermometer was 3-4 degrees F higher than the set temperature on the door control panel.  We called LG service about this and their tech came, took some temperature measurements and then explained that everything was fine since "the actual temperature inside the unit can be within 5 to 10 degrees of the set temperature" (We got the same reply when contacting LG service online and by phone).  We lived with a lower setting (34F) to maintain an internal temp of 37F.  In late April of 2023, we found that the internal temps were on the rise despite lowering the control temp to its lowest setting of 33F.  We were getting internal temps of 40-41F (with the control temp set to 33F), which is pushing against the max temp for safe food storage in fridges recommended by the US FDA.   Since the one-year warranty had expired three weeks earlier, we called a service person who replaced a fan, the back panel containing a thermistor, and finally the main control board.  All this took 4 months and cost us roughly $800.  When all the servicing was complete, we still had to set the control panel temp to the minimum setting (33F) to maintain a safe internal temperature of 37-38F.  As a result, we perceive a potential danger to others because of the inability of the LG LRMXC2206S to maintain temperatures that are safe for food storage as defined by the US FDA.  Please note that the freezer worked well throughout.

cpsc_product_name: Industrial Three-Panel Mirrors
incident_product_description:
The product was an approximately 8' x 3' x 3/8" sheet of clear, tempered glass installed in a master bathroom shower. We are not experts in glass so we can't say much regarding the specific attributes or quality of the glass itself. The glass was installed in our newly constructed condo in late 2017 or early 2018. We do not know the exact purchase or installation date, but based on the glass's presence during our walk-throughs of the condo, the glass had been installed by mid-January 2018 at the latest which is the basis for the estimated "purchase date" of 1/15/2018 below. We do not have any information about the clamps or other mounting hardware, but we believe they were provided by the installer.

Photos of the manufacturer markings on the glass have been provided. The markings on the exploded panel are very difficult to photograph, but from visual inspection, they appear to match the markings on the adjacent panel (also included). The markings appear to read:
[triangle-symbol] QUALITY GLASS
SAFE?Y TEMP?RED
ANSI Z97.1 2015
16 CFR 1201 ??
SGCC 2983 3/8 UA

"SGCC 2983 3/8 UA" appears to identify a specific certification by the "Safety Glazing Certification Council" for Quality Glass & Mirror Inc. of Mount Prospect, IL, which is consistent with the "QUALITY GLASS" labeling. The SGCC search function can be accessed here: https://www.sgcc.org/Certified-Products-Search.aspx, and searching by SGCC number 2983 provides the attached certificate from SGCC concerning the current certification for Quality Glass & Mirror.

The SGCC search function also provides a history of certification testing for the 2983 product, which can be viewed by selecting 'History' from the search results. The 2983 results date back to 2009. A screenshot of the list is attached, as are the three testing records that pre-date our early 2018 installation. We note that the certifications are typically performed every 6-8 months, EXCEPT that there was a 15-month gap in certifications from 8/4/2016 until 11/3/2017. Without knowing more about the inventory practices of the manufacturer, or how long the glass may have been in inventory by the installer, we are unable to form a view regarding which testing certificate (or whether any testing certificate) was in place when the exploded glass was tempered. Given the abnormal and significant gap in certification testing reported by SGCC, and given the explosion of our glass, which may have been caused by a manufacturing or material defect, we strongly urge CPSC to investigate this further.

cpsc_product_name: 2020 and 2021 ZFORCE 950 Sport Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles (ROVs)
incident_product_description:
Corestar Gloves

UPC 7 39210 34361 3

Model Re-Order #: SF-3400L (written on box)

Ordered through Amazon.com PRIME. Product is listed as "The Essential Goods Disposable Clear Vinyl Glove/Large Size/100 count/Non-Latex Power-Free Ultra Strong Non-sterile" for home, office, kitchen use. Described as puncture free and safe for use for those with latex and powder allergy.  I have a latex allergy. Box states "MADE IN CHINA" There is a white sticker with barcode #X002HZKPL on the box.  When I peeled the label back it revealed another barcode #39210 34361, Purchased on Amazon.com 12/24/2020.  Used it for the first time 4/29/2021.  Only had it on for about 1 hour doing light housekeeping/cleaning.  When I removed the gloves, my hands were reddened where the the gloves were on.  It continued over the next 12 hours to get redder, itchy and swollen.  The redness and swelling progressed up to mid forearm on both arms. I had immediately washed my hands after taking off the gloves but there must have been some allergen present in the glove (latex?) that caused this severe allergic reaction.  I ended up going to Urgent Care, placed on Triamcinolone and Clabetasol high steroid topicals, oral antihistamines, and underwent IV infusions of both [REDACTED] (steroid) and Diphenhydramine (antihistamine) to control the allergic reaction.  I was also prescribed an epi-pen (to be used if I should go into anaphylactic shock) which cost me $118 not covered by my insurance.   I was in pain from the acute swelling.  Hands looked like I had boxing gloves on.   I was also in emotional distress.  I contacted Amazon.com and all they did was apologize and give me a $10 gift certificate with my next order for "any inconvenience" I experienced.   I requested that they do more quality control of their products, as someone with an allergy to latex and glove powder like I do should not have to go through this.  I suggested that they stop this vendor from claiming that the product is latex-free and powder-free as it obviously is not, which is false advertisement and could lead to possible death if the reaction is severe enough.  As of this writing, August 25, 2021, the skin on my hands continue to slough off.  My allergist and dermatologist both told me this may continue on for months as it was a severe allergic reaction.  This has been going on since April 29, 2021.

incident_product_description:
Health By Habit brand Men's multivitamin (Megamulti for Mega mileage) white bottle with gray.  60 count bottle.
And Health By Habit brand Women's multivitamin  (Supermulti for Super women) White bottle with pink. 60 count bottle.

The product is fine, but there is a warning label on the bottle that says Warning: Accidental Overdose of Iron-containing products is a leading cause of fatal poisoning in children under 6. Keep this product out of reach of children. In case of accidental overdose, call a doctor or poison control center immediately. 

I was shocked to read this, because the product is so easily opened. There is child safety precautions on other products that are much less dangerous. Why doesn't this one require it? 

To open, you simply turn the lid of the bottle and it reveals a little window where the product is dispensed. It's easy to spin, there is little resistance, and it's kind of fun to do.

incident_model: EMF&5G Blocker 4 pcs for Mobile Phones 2021 Latest
incident_product_description:
The product consists of a pack of four self-adhesive stickers. The stickers have a metallic gold appearance and are round, about the diameter of a quarter. They are printed with an image of an outline of a human body (in a sort of Vitruvian Man pose). The stickers arrive in packaging consisting of a printed cardstock backer with descriptions of their alleged benefits, and suggested use cases such as sticking to cell phones or appliances. This backer is then enclosed in a plastic wrap envelope, with four of the stickers and backers inside.
The supposed purpose of these products is to protect the user from harm that may allegedly be caused by electromagnetic radiation associated with the 5G cellular telephone network. The package copy includes such phrases as "Negative Ion+Far Infrared," "Caring for Health," and "Preventing Radiation."
Here are some more phrases from the product's listing on Amazon:
"About this item
    Absorb and transfer electromagnetic radiation waves by using special materials
    Reduce mobile phone radiation injury on the human brain of 99.99%
    Applicable for Mobile phone, Laptop, Microwave oven, TV set, Refrigerator, Hair dryer and other electric appliances"
(This supposed use case is dubious--it may be appropriate to call these items a scam, as there is no scientific basis for the statements the product makes, or for the alleged issues the products claim to address).

Stickers like this appear to be sold under a variety of "Generic" brands on Amazon and [REDACTED]. This is just one example of "anti-radiation stickers."

incident_product_description:
RE: SAMSUNG FRIGERATOR
Model # RF23R6201SR/AA
Serial # 0BBS43AMB00538Y
Ticket # [REDACTED]
I purchased this Samsung refrigerator in April 14, 2020. As of May 2022, the freezer does not keep anything frozen. I have lost hundreds of dollars worth of food. I called Samsung. They assigned me to 3 different appliance repair shops: [REDACTED] ALL OF WHICH NO LONGER SERVICE FOR SAMSUNG, AND TWO DON’T EVEN SERVICE MY AREA.

I was told that since it was past the one year warranty, that there is nothing Samsung will do to repair my refrigerator nor refund me my money. 

I previously owned a [REDACTED] refrigerator from 1996 to 2020 with no issues whatsoever. I own the Samsung refrigerator for only 2 years and cannot get it serviced.

This service is completely unacceptable. I understand in the state of Indiana that the company is expected to give me a full refund if it's within the 7 years of warranty expiration.

cpsc_product_name: Model Years 2020-2021 RZR PRO XP, PRO XP4 and Model Year 2021 RZR Turbo S, Turbo S4, XP Turbo and XP 4 Turbo ROV
incident_product_description:
This is a formal complaint.
Lowes sold me an 'inferior' Samsung refrigerator on December 18th 2020.
Model # RF27T5241
Invoice # [REDACTED]
Order # [REDACTED]
Store # 1683 (Venice Fl.)
I also purchased the 5 year Protection Plan.....
1) I now have the Top Ice Maker quit
2) The temperature in the refrigerator varies 10 degrees up and down.
3) The same in the Freezer, 10 degrees up and down.
I also have two friends that have Samsung refrigerators and theirs has had the very same issues with theirs as well. As I [REDAACTED] the issue, I have found that this type of problem has been going on for over 10 years with Samsung refrigerators.
Why do you keep selling customers these inferior products?
I am deaf, and phone calls for me are next to impossible.
Yes, I will call to get a fix ticket, but first I will tell you that the problem doesn't go away. My one friend has had to replace his Ice maker 3 times! So, even if I get a new Ice maker, that may only be temporary, due to all that I've read and my friends experience.
It saddens me, that the salesman that I had, gave me a sales pitch of it being one of the very best models, maybe he meant one of the worst!!
* My next email I send out will be telling the BBB of this problem.
* Then I will be filling a formal complaint with the FTC
* Then Samsung......probably a waste of time......
I doubt very much that I am an isolated case. Please do not sell these inferior products.
I'm 73 years old, and even my refrigerated medications are possibly being compromised due to temperature malfunctions.
Thank you for listening
[REDACTED]

cpsc_product_name: Sure Scents 2-1 Peaceful Stream/Moonlit Waves Candles
incident_product_description:
Sure Scents/ 

Model (Peaceful Stream/Moonlit Waves

UPC 639277 982514 3

.  We received a complaint yesterday about a 2in1 Sure Scents candle (Peaceful Stream/Moonlit Waves) catching fire and exploding which was purchased from Dollar Tree by [REDACTED] in Dover.  We visited the same store that the complainant purchased the candle from this morning ([REDACTED]) and purchased 2 of the candles.  We also purchased Sure Scents 2in1 in Hawaiian/ Sweet Vanilla and Ambient brand in Coconut & Beachwood.  We conducted a test burn of these items in normal conditions.  Within 10 minutes of lighting these candles the Sure Scents (Peaceful Stream/Moonlit Waves) wax ignited onto a flame reaching 6 inches tall. The flame temperature of this candle was over 800 degrees.  The candles with no issue had a flame  temperature of around 200 degrees.  We allowed it to burn for an hour this way before extinguishing it and the entire test was recorded.  Both glass containers failed and broke apart.  The other two candles had no issues.

HD Hudson illu-Mist 40001 one-gallon & 40002 two-gallon battery-powered garden sprayers. 

Model illu-Mist 40001 one-gallon & 40002 two-gallon batt

This recall involves illu-Mist 40001 one-gallon & 40002 two-gallon battery-powered garden sprayers.  The sprayers have a plastic triangle-shaped handle in gray with teal blue trim and a white tank with “illu-Mist” printed on the front side of the tank.  The sprayers measure 15.5 inches and 19.5 inches in height when assembled.  
 
Remedy:
Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled battery-powered sprayers, remove the battery tray, and look for a brown battery.  If the battery is brown, consumers should remove the battery and tray and dispose of them in accordance with local laws for disposal of lithium-ion batteries, and contact HD Hudson for a free replacement battery and tray.  Always follow proper battery use and storage procedures as listed in the instructions.
Incidents/Injuries:
The firm has received four reports of batteries overheating, including one report of a battery melting and catching fire resulting in less than $100 in property damage.

incident_product_description:
I purchased a New Leaf extended warranty when I purchased my Samsung refrigerator model # RF265BEAESR/AA from Plessers on May 30 2017. I have had nothing but issues with this refrigerator as can be seen from all the service calls listed below. I called in again today as the issue occurred again. I recorded the call and I was informed that if an issue occurs within 60 days of the previous service call, for the same issue, there would be another service call and my issue doesn't fall within the Federal Lemon Law, Magnusom Moss Act. This potentially could mean that I go through service calls within perpetuality until the contract ends: 
- Samsung original warranty claim - May 3, 2019 - ticket #[REDACTED] replaced evaporator cover, ice kit, gasket, and temp sensor
- New leaf warranty - Sept 2021  Replaced water/ice dispenser sensor 
- New leaf warranty - Feb 2022  Replaced ice kit/ computer board 
- New leaf warranty - Feb 17 2022  ice issue continues, service provider came out, but then returned the ticket to new leaf - New leaf warranty - Feb 21 2022 - service provider canceled and rescheduled ice issue continues,  
- New leaf warranty - Feb 25 2022 - Rescheduled service - ordered the same parts as the earlier Feb 2022 service call ice issue continues - New leaf warranty 
- March 7, 2022 - New service call to replace the same ice maker parts as Feb 2022 - Replaced ice kit/ computer board - New leaf warranty 
- April 19, 2022 - Called New Leaf and explained the Lemon Law; and informed that it doesn't fall under the lemon law since the repair is within 60 days of the previous repair. They want to keep a continuous repair cycle until the contract is over. Same issue with ice machine and now a message on the interactive screen saying if you don't contact the repair center food could be damaged. New Leaf rep said they would send a copy of the contract. This lack of service is unacceptable and I'm looking for a full refund as this issue has and will continue.

incident_model: EMF&5G Blocker 4 pcs for Mobile Phones 2021 Latest
incident_product_description:
The product consists of a pack of four self-adhesive stickers. The stickers have a metallic gold appearance and are round, about the diameter of a quarter. They are printed with an image of an outline of a human body (in a sort of Vitruvian Man pose). The stickers arrive in packaging consisting of a printed cardstock backer with descriptions of their alleged benefits, and suggested use cases such as sticking to cell phones or appliances. This backer is then enclosed in a plastic wrap envelope, with four of the stickers and backers inside.
The supposed purpose of these products is to protect the user from harm that may allegedly be caused by electromagnetic radiation associated with the 5G cellular telephone network. The package copy includes such phrases as "Negative Ion+Far Infrared," "Caring for Health," and "Preventing Radiation."
Here are some more phrases from the product's listing on Amazon:
"About this item
    Absorb and transfer electromagnetic radiation waves by using special materials
    Reduce mobile phone radiation injury on the human brain of 99.99%
    Applicable for Mobile phone, Laptop, Microwave oven, TV set, Refrigerator, Hair dryer and other electric appliances"
(This supposed use case is dubious--it may be appropriate to call these items a scam, as there is no scientific basis for the statements the product makes, or for the alleged issues the products claim to address).

Stickers like this appear to be sold under a variety of "Generic" brands on Amazon and [REDACTED]. This is just one example of "anti-radiation stickers."

cpsc_product_name: illu-Mist Battery-Powered Garden Sprayers
incident_product_description:
HD Hudson illu-Mist 40001 one-gallon & 40002 two-gallon battery-powered garden sprayers. 

Model illu-Mist 40001 one-gallon & 40002 two-gallon batt

This recall involves illu-Mist 40001 one-gallon & 40002 two-gallon battery-powered garden sprayers.  The sprayers have a plastic triangle-shaped handle in gray with teal blue trim and a white tank with “illu-Mist” printed on the front side of the tank.  The sprayers measure 15.5 inches and 19.5 inches in height when assembled.  
 
Remedy:
Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled battery-powered sprayers, remove the battery tray, and look for a brown battery.  If the battery is brown, consumers should remove the battery and tray and dispose of them in accordance with local laws for disposal of lithium-ion batteries, and contact HD Hudson for a free replacement battery and tray.  Always follow proper battery use and storage procedures as listed in the instructions.
Incidents/Injuries:
The firm has received four reports of batteries overheating, including one report of a battery melting and catching fire resulting in less than $100 in property damage.

incident_product_description:
We want to make you aware of a serious problem with this item.

We recently purchased several BlendJet 2 products from Costco in December. We gave some out as Christmas gifts and then kept one for ourselves.

We currently have Serial #5356023156 in our possession.

This morning we found out that the ends of two blades were broken off. We found one of the pieces inside the cup we were getting ready to drink, however, the 2nd piece we did not find and believe my son may have swallowed it prior to our discovery at an earlier time.

We don't know how the blade ends could have broken off, The hardest type of items we put inside the Blenjet are ice cubes with water, which the manufacturer's  website states the BlendJet 2 can do.

Please advise what other information you may need to address our concern.    Thank you.

cpsc_product_name: John Deere XUV590 and XUV590 S4 Gator™ utility vehicles
incident_product_description:
The service and parking brakes failed due to failure of the front brake bellcrank that transfers the brake pedal force to the rear brake bellcrank that actuates the wet brakes within the hydrostatic transmission.  The front brake bellcrank is a zinc alloy casting that bolts onto the brake pedal shaft with two bolts.  The bellcrank failed with two longitudinal fractures about 180 degrees opposed.  It appears the bolt hole closest to the bellcrank arm was the stress riser.  It appears the failure was brittle failure preceded by plastic deformation.  The arm of the bellcrank and the bellcrank connecting arm separated from the brake pedal shaft, preventing brake pedal force from reaching the rear brake bellcrank.  The tractor normal slows and stops on level ground if the forward or reverse control pedal is not depressed.  Stopping the tractor required lowering the front loader bucket into contact with the ground.

The broken front brake bellcrank was given to Blanchard Equipment, Inc., the John Deere dealer from which the tractor was purchased.   Their manager stated he would initiate a defect report to be submitted to John Deere.  I do not know the status of the defect report or any response to it.

The bottom of the tank on the mower was bowed down in the center of bottom of tank.  Mower operates fine, but strong fuel odor persists.  The tank seems to made of a thin gauge of plastic, too thin in my opinion.    The fuel tank is part number 532433006.   This mower was produced for Poulan Pro by Husqvarna Group.  I have a older mower of this same design, a [REDACTED] Riding Mower, again produced by Husqvarna Group also with same issue and it is reported as well. This fuel could leak out onto mower and onto area where Riding Mower is parked and provide a ignition source from fuel fumes or fuel itself. cpsc_product_name: Deep Frame Mirrors
incident_product_description:
Fisher Price forest fun green grove bouncer sold at target. Product # x7037.

Model X7037

The recline is deep; the front of the vibrating bouncer is 7.25” above the ground, and the back of the seat is 12.5” above the ground. It requires a D battery which is secured by a Phillips head screw. It has a 3-point harness; only the side straps tighten, there is no adjustment for the center crotch strap. The front legs are a width of 21.75”. The back of the leg support, underneath the bounced is 11.5” wide. The back of the seat is 18” high, and the seat of it is 10.5” deep. It has a removable bar with 3 spinning toys, one of which is also a rattle (center toy, and it has a dangling mushroom dropping an additional 3” from it). The side toys, at the lowest, are 11.5” above the lowest part of the fabric seat (where the crotch strap is sewn); at its highest, the entire toy bar is 15” above the lowest part of the fabric seat. The frame is metal, with rubber bumpers in 4 places. The part of the seat where my son’s legs would be lifts up when the seat is unoccupied to allow the cover to be removed and the battery changed for the vibrating function. The seat is less than 30” from the front of its base to the top of the fabric seat (difficult to measure as it’s at an angle).

cpsc_product_name: Model Year 2021 RZR Pro XP and RZR Pro XP 4 Recreational Off-Road Vehicles (ROVs)
incident_product_description:
Glowforge laser cutting system

Model Glowforge Pro

I own a Glowforge laser cutting system. The company is based out of Seattle. After a little over a year of use I have come to the conclusion that these machines appear to be built using very unsafe design practices and their use could lead to catastrophic fire. Electrical faults are rife. The component layout is dangerous. The tube cooling capacity is poor and susceptible to overheating. The main cable that controls the laser head is exceptionally easy to damage during cleaning or maintenance, and the insulation wears off alarmingly quickly, exposing the conductor traces. The main cable also runs very close the stepper motor. These motors run very warm and there is not adequate separation between it and the cable to ensure safety (or reliability). The cable then runs through the drag chain, where it is subject to a great deal of friction and wear. In addition, the machine is advertised as a 'Pro' device that is able to cut wood, acrylic and more. However, the electronics, heat sink and exhaust fan are all located next to each other in the same area of the machine. The accumulation of dirt in fumes in both the fan and over those critical components is alarming. The design reduces cooling capacity over time. Finally, there is a red tension cable that carries around 26,000 volts and feeds the laser tube. This cable is not designed to be flexed or strained at all and is very fragile. However, the high tension cable is installed next to the main ribbon cable (mentioned above) which carry control signs. Mains and high voltage signals should also be separated by a considerable margin for safety - the potential for noise and errors passing between the cables could cause glitches, faults and represent a fire hazard. The final area I am concerned with is the ducting supplied with the system. The ductwork expands every time the machine is in use and the creasing and uncreasing cause punctures in the duct, allowing cutting fumes to vent into the user's work space. The ductwork is not rated for fume extraction. Overall, all of these flaws combined means not only is the machine being falsely advertised as a 'Pro' commercial production unit, it's incredibly unsafe. The vast majority of these lasers are sold and marketed to at-home hobbyists, teachers, and students who would not typically be familiar with the threat of electrical failure and fire these design flaws could lead to. The Glowforge Owner's forum (which the company runs) is filled with many comments/tickets about fires in these machines, so the company knows these can lead to life-threatening problems but has done nothing to correct these issues. I feel very strongly there should be a recall on these machines.

This recall involves illu-Mist 40001 one-gallon & 40002 two-gallon battery-powered garden sprayers. Remedy:
Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled battery-powered sprayers, remove the battery tray, and look for a brown battery.  If the battery is brown, consumers should remove the battery and tray and dispose of them in accordance with local laws for disposal of lithium-ion batteries, and contact HD Hudson for a free replacement battery and tray. Incidents/Injuries:
The firm has received four reports of batteries overheating, including one report of a battery melting and catching fire resulting in less than $100 in property damage.

cpsc_product_name: John Deere compact utility tractors
incident_product_description:
The service and parking brakes failed due to failure of the front brake bellcrank that transfers the brake pedal force to the rear brake bellcrank that actuates the wet brakes within the hydrostatic transmission.  The front brake bellcrank is a zinc alloy casting that bolts onto the brake pedal shaft with two bolts.  The bellcrank failed with two longitudinal fractures about 180 degrees opposed.  It appears the bolt hole closest to the bellcrank arm was the stress riser.  It appears the failure was brittle failure preceded by plastic deformation.  The arm of the bellcrank and the bellcrank connecting arm separated from the brake pedal shaft, preventing brake pedal force from reaching the rear brake bellcrank.  The tractor normal slows and stops on level ground if the forward or reverse control pedal is not depressed.  Stopping the tractor required lowering the front loader bucket into contact with the ground.

The broken front brake bellcrank was given to Blanchard Equipment, Inc., the John Deere dealer from which the tractor was purchased.   Their manager stated he would initiate a defect report to be submitted to John Deere.  I do not know the status of the defect report or any response to it.

On Wednesday, April 29th 2020, I traded in a Blue Rhino tank that was previously purchased at Lowe's for a replacement one. When my son attempted to connect it to our [REDACTED]  grill the gas leaked all over his face. He was very upset that he breathed the propane. He immediately removed the tank and noticed several cracks in the seal. We brought back the tank the same day as purchase. The Lowe's associate immediately replaced the tank. The replacement tank did not have issues when my son attached it to our grill. Leaking gas is always a bit scary of a situation.

cpsc_product_name: Usines Giant Factories Gas Water Heaters with Emerson control valves
incident_product_description:
Honeywell gas control valve on a [REDACTED] water heater.
We have a water heater with a Honeywell gas (LP) control valve (model WV8840B5077) that has been running too hot causing skin burns.  This control valve was having issues in 2017 and was replaced by the installer.  Yet we're again experiencing the same issues.  The installer is planning to replace it again.  The issues we've been having include:
1- Runs too hot causing burns.
2- It shuts off randomly and requires re-start once or twice per week.
In our opinion there should have been a recall by Honeywell as the installer told us that there has been a lot of complaints about the same issues we've been having.

incident_product_description:
Sure Scents/ 

Model (Peaceful Stream/Moonlit Waves

UPC 639277 982514 3

.  We received a complaint yesterday about a 2in1 Sure Scents candle (Peaceful Stream/Moonlit Waves) catching fire and exploding which was purchased from Dollar Tree by [REDACTED] in Dover.  We visited the same store that the complainant purchased the candle from this morning ([REDACTED]) and purchased 2 of the candles.  We also purchased Sure Scents 2in1 in Hawaiian/ Sweet Vanilla and Ambient brand in Coconut & Beachwood.  We conducted a test burn of these items in normal conditions.  Within 10 minutes of lighting these candles the Sure Scents (Peaceful Stream/Moonlit Waves) wax ignited onto a flame reaching 6 inches tall. The flame temperature of this candle was over 800 degrees.  The candles with no issue had a flame  temperature of around 200 degrees.  We allowed it to burn for an hour this way before extinguishing it and the entire test was recorded.  Both glass containers failed and broke apart.  The other two candles had no issues.

From Amazon:
Hamilton Beach 31103A Countertop Oven with Convection and Rotisserie, Metallic
Maximum versatility - including rotisserie
Extra-large capacity - fits two 12" pizzas, two 9" x 13" casseroles, or two cake pansThis oven is 110 voltage only It is packaged in SIOC packaging to avoid damage in shipping
Revolving rotisserie - meat self-bastes as it turns - fits a 5 lb chicken
Convection setting bakes faster and more evenly than traditional oven;Bake & broil settings with 2 hour timer1311 H x 2062 W x 1654 D
Durable stainless steel construction
Hamilton Beach Countertop Oven with Convection & Rotisserie 31103
Small enough to fit on your kitchen counter, but large enough to help you prepare for any meal or party, the Hamilton Beach Countertop Oven with Convection & Rotisserie boasts full-size oven performance in compact, energy-efficient form.Designed with both kitchen style and practicality in mind, the Countertop Oven with Convection & Rotisserie is portable and countertop convenient. It's packed with versatile cooking options that range from baking cakes to crisping cookies to broiling salmon to roasting an entire 5 lb. chicken, roast or pork. There's no need to spend extra time cooking separate meals for the pickier ones, either. The wide interior and adjustable cooking racks provide double the space for cooking multiple foods at once.What's more, this oven is ideal for anyone, anywhere and anytime. It can replace the microwave in your office, offer easy cooking access for the elderly, serve as a staple for apartment dwellers or provide snack enthusiasts with a little added treat.


PRODUCT FEATURE BENEFITS
Uses 49% less energy than a typical kitchen oven
Extra-large capacity accommodates two 12" pizzas, two 9"x13" casseroles, two cake pans, two sheets of cookies or a 5 lb. chicken
Easy-clean, nonstick oven interior
Includes two oven racks, large enamel-coated baking pan, small baking pan and broil rack
Broil rack also stacks directly on small baking pan for roasting meats
Includes rotisserie accessories: rotisserie lift and forks with rod (skewer) Slide-out, full-width crumb/drip tray
Easy-to-read temperature dial on front control panel can be adjusted to desired or pre-set temperatures
Easy-to-read function dial on front control panel can be adjusted to four pre-programmed settings: BAKE, CONVECTION, BROIL, ROTISSERIE
Power indicator light
2-hour cooking timer with audible tone and automatic shutoff

Gives You the Choice of Bake, Convection, Broil or Rotisserie
Don't want to heat up the entire kitchen or slave away over a hot burner? No sweat – the Hamilton Beach Countertop Oven provides extra capacity for second oven convenience as well as four ways to cook: BAKE, CONVECTION, BROIL and ROTISSERIE.

A 9"x13" baking pan can be found in most kitchens in North America, used for making everything from lasagna to brownies. Not only does this oven fit two 9"x13" pans at once, unlike conventional ovens without convection technology, the Countertop Oven with Convection and Rotisserie comes fully equipped. Instead of having heat come from just one central area and no fan to "stir-up" or circulate air evenly all over, this oven's convection technology utilizes a top and bottom heating element and a built-in fan to distribute heat evenly for a uniform temperature. That way, bakers can choose between traditional baking – ideal for cupcakes, cakes and soft baked goods – or convection baking – ideal for a crispy pizzas, cookies or even taquitos. Use the rotisserie feature for roasted chicken, beef roast or pork roast. Note: Only upper heating elements will be on during the rotisserie mode.

TIPS & CARE
Before cooking with the oven, always PREHEAT for approximately 5 minutes. Check pan manufacturer's directions for oven-safe rating. Do not cover the crumb/drip tray or any part of the oven in aluminum foil (causes overheating); however, use of aluminum foil to partially cover casseroles or some foods is acceptable. Visit foodsafety. gov for more safe cooking temperature information.

The full-width crumb/drip tray slides out from the front, allowing easy washing. For the best oven performance, cleaning should be done regularly. Unplug first and allow oven to cool before interior and exterior cleaning. For interior cleaning: wipe oven walls, bottom tray and glass door with a damp, soapy cloth, but do not scratch or damage heating element tube. Repeat with a damp, clean cloth. All removable parts should be hand washed in warm, soapy water as well. For stubborn interior stains, use a plastic scouring pad. For exterior cleaning: wipe oven walls with a damp cloth, but do not use abrasive cleansers or metal scouring pads; this can scrape/scratch the surface.

cpsc_product_name: Escalade Sports Tennis Tables
incident_product_description:
WMNS NIKE AIR VAPOR ADVANTAGE

Model  599394

UPC 00888408050735


Nike has been making defective shows for many years. (in the case of these pink shoes costing over $ 100 they were only worn once!)
They have caused me to not only fall on the tennis court on many occassions as the sole comes apart from the shoe... thus this could have  caused serious injuries due to they faulty construction.
This is not only older shoes but some new shoes..and not heavily worn shoes .Some were only worn once or twice and the rubber sole has come apart from the rest of the shoe.
( I am happy to send pictures of nearly 12 pairs!)

Last year in February I alerted your Customer Service department about defective 599364 shoes!
At that at time I sent them 2 pairs of shoes that they deemed to not be Nike’s fault.
In addition , our representative seemed more than unconcerned about my safety or that of others while performing sports.
His name was [REDACTED], Elite Services. In fact..I called him several months later and he never returned my phone call.

Since contacting your unhelpful representative in February I have had 3 additional pairs of the 599364, 2 of which had only been worn twice, and a pair of your 487996 after only 3 wears.

Not only is his extremely dangerous for falls and worse during play..but has now become very very costly!
599364. I now have 9 pairs! Which have fallen apart.

1)	599364- 607 pink worn 3 times…second pair bought
2)	487996-414 blue worn 3 times
3)	599364-410 blue only worn a few times
Other pairs of 599364-106,607, 107,410,105 and 100 fell apart.

Sadly I have tried contacting Nike’s Executive office only to be thwarted away and not being able to speak to anyone..EVEN AN EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT.
Nike seems to be not at all concerned with Customer Service or SAFETY!
They should clearly be penalized for not only causing injuries, but for wearing “blinder’s” when it comes to their products defective construction.

.  We received a complaint yesterday about a 2in1 Sure Scents candle (Peaceful Stream/Moonlit Waves) catching fire and exploding which was purchased from Dollar Tree by [REDACTED] in Dover.  We visited the same store that the complainant purchased the candle from this morning ([REDACTED]) and purchased 2 of the candles.  We also purchased Sure Scents 2in1 in Hawaiian/ Sweet Vanilla and Ambient brand in Coconut & Beachwood.  We conducted a test burn of these items in normal conditions.  Within 10 minutes of lighting these candles the Sure Scents (Peaceful Stream/Moonlit Waves) wax ignited onto a flame reaching 6 inches tall. The flame temperature of this candle was over 800 degrees.  The candles with no issue had a flame  temperature of around 200 degrees.  We allowed it to burn for an hour this way before extinguishing it and the entire test was recorded.  Both glass containers failed and broke apart.  The other two candles had no issues.

incident_product_description:
HD Hudson illu-Mist 40001 one-gallon & 40002 two-gallon battery-powered garden sprayers. 

Model illu-Mist 40001 one-gallon & 40002 two-gallon batt

This recall involves illu-Mist 40001 one-gallon & 40002 two-gallon battery-powered garden sprayers.  The sprayers have a plastic triangle-shaped handle in gray with teal blue trim and a white tank with “illu-Mist” printed on the front side of the tank.  The sprayers measure 15.5 inches and 19.5 inches in height when assembled.  
 
Remedy:
Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled battery-powered sprayers, remove the battery tray, and look for a brown battery.  If the battery is brown, consumers should remove the battery and tray and dispose of them in accordance with local laws for disposal of lithium-ion batteries, and contact HD Hudson for a free replacement battery and tray.  Always follow proper battery use and storage procedures as listed in the instructions.
Incidents/Injuries:
The firm has received four reports of batteries overheating, including one report of a battery melting and catching fire resulting in less than $100 in property damage.

incident_product_description:
HD Hudson illu-Mist 40001 one-gallon & 40002 two-gallon battery-powered garden sprayers. 

Model illu-Mist 40001 one-gallon & 40002 two-gallon batt

This recall involves illu-Mist 40001 one-gallon & 40002 two-gallon battery-powered garden sprayers.  The sprayers have a plastic triangle-shaped handle in gray with teal blue trim and a white tank with “illu-Mist” printed on the front side of the tank.  The sprayers measure 15.5 inches and 19.5 inches in height when assembled.  
 
Remedy:
Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled battery-powered sprayers, remove the battery tray, and look for a brown battery.  If the battery is brown, consumers should remove the battery and tray and dispose of them in accordance with local laws for disposal of lithium-ion batteries, and contact HD Hudson for a free replacement battery and tray.  Always follow proper battery use and storage procedures as listed in the instructions.
Incidents/Injuries:
The firm has received four reports of batteries overheating, including one report of a battery melting and catching fire resulting in less than $100 in property damage.

cpsc_product_name: Kroger Arthritis Pain Acetaminophen, 225 count bottles
incident_product_description:
Corestar Gloves

UPC 7 39210 34361 3

Model Re-Order #: SF-3400L (written on box)

Ordered through Amazon.com PRIME. Product is listed as "The Essential Goods Disposable Clear Vinyl Glove/Large Size/100 count/Non-Latex Power-Free Ultra Strong Non-sterile" for home, office, kitchen use. Described as puncture free and safe for use for those with latex and powder allergy.  I have a latex allergy. Box states "MADE IN CHINA" There is a white sticker with barcode #X002HZKPL on the box.  When I peeled the label back it revealed another barcode #39210 34361, Purchased on Amazon.com 12/24/2020.  Used it for the first time 4/29/2021.  Only had it on for about 1 hour doing light housekeeping/cleaning.  When I removed the gloves, my hands were reddened where the the gloves were on.  It continued over the next 12 hours to get redder, itchy and swollen.  The redness and swelling progressed up to mid forearm on both arms. I had immediately washed my hands after taking off the gloves but there must have been some allergen present in the glove (latex?) that caused this severe allergic reaction.  I ended up going to Urgent Care, placed on Triamcinolone and Clabetasol high steroid topicals, oral antihistamines, and underwent IV infusions of both [REDACTED] (steroid) and Diphenhydramine (antihistamine) to control the allergic reaction.  I was also prescribed an epi-pen (to be used if I should go into anaphylactic shock) which cost me $118 not covered by my insurance.   I was in pain from the acute swelling.  Hands looked like I had boxing gloves on.   I was also in emotional distress.  I contacted Amazon.com and all they did was apologize and give me a $10 gift certificate with my next order for "any inconvenience" I experienced.   I requested that they do more quality control of their products, as someone with an allergy to latex and glove powder like I do should not have to go through this.  I suggested that they stop this vendor from claiming that the product is latex-free and powder-free as it obviously is not, which is false advertisement and could lead to possible death if the reaction is severe enough.  As of this writing, August 25, 2021, the skin on my hands continue to slough off.  My allergist and dermatologist both told me this may continue on for months as it was a severe allergic reaction.  This has been going on since April 29, 2021.

incident_product_description:
LG LRMXC2206S French Door Refrigerator/Freezer  Stainless Steel,  Counter Depth     34-3/4" Wide, 31-1/4" Depth, and 69-3/4" High

We purchased an LG LRMXC2206S in April, 2022, and once installed, we placed digital thermometers in the fridge and also in the freezer to monitor the internal temps.  After a few days to equilibrate, the internal fridge temperatures recorded by the thermometer was 3-4 degrees F higher than the set temperature on the door control panel.  We called LG service about this and their tech came, took some temperature measurements and then explained that everything was fine since "the actual temperature inside the unit can be within 5 to 10 degrees of the set temperature" (We got the same reply when contacting LG service online and by phone).  We lived with a lower setting (34F) to maintain an internal temp of 37F.  In late April of 2023, we found that the internal temps were on the rise despite lowering the control temp to its lowest setting of 33F.  We were getting internal temps of 40-41F (with the control temp set to 33F), which is pushing against the max temp for safe food storage in fridges recommended by the US FDA.   Since the one-year warranty had expired three weeks earlier, we called a service person who replaced a fan, the back panel containing a thermistor, and finally the main control board.  All this took 4 months and cost us roughly $800.  When all the servicing was complete, we still had to set the control panel temp to the minimum setting (33F) to maintain a safe internal temperature of 37-38F.  As a result, we perceive a potential danger to others because of the inability of the LG LRMXC2206S to maintain temperatures that are safe for food storage as defined by the US FDA.  Please note that the freezer worked well throughout.

Hamilton Beach Countertop Oven with Convection & Rotisserie 31103
Small enough to fit on your kitchen counter, but large enough to help you prepare for any meal or party, the Hamilton Beach Countertop Oven with Convection & Rotisserie boasts full-size oven performance in compact, energy-efficient form.Designed with both kitchen style and practicality in mind, the Countertop Oven with Convection & Rotisserie is portable and countertop convenient. It's packed with versatile cooking options that range from baking cakes to crisping cookies to broiling salmon to roasting an entire 5 lb. chicken, roast or pork. There's no need to spend extra time cooking separate meals for the pickier ones, either. The wide interior and adjustable cooking racks provide double the space for cooking multiple foods at once.What's more, this oven is ideal for anyone, anywhere and anytime. It can replace the microwave in your office, offer easy cooking access for the elderly, serve as a staple for apartment dwellers or provide snack enthusiasts with a little added treat.


PRODUCT FEATURE BENEFITS
Uses 49% less energy than a typical kitchen oven
Extra-large capacity accommodates two 12" pizzas, two 9"x13" casseroles, two cake pans, two sheets of cookies or a 5 lb. chicken
Easy-clean, nonstick oven interior
Includes two oven racks, large enamel-coated baking pan, small baking pan and broil rack
Broil rack also stacks directly on small baking pan for roasting meats
Includes rotisserie accessories: rotisserie lift and forks with rod (skewer) Slide-out, full-width crumb/drip tray
Easy-to-read temperature dial on front control panel can be adjusted to desired or pre-set temperatures
Easy-to-read function dial on front control panel can be adjusted to four pre-programmed settings: BAKE, CONVECTION, BROIL, ROTISSERIE
Power indicator light
2-hour cooking timer with audible tone and automatic shutoff

Gives You the Choice of Bake, Convection, Broil or Rotisserie
Don't want to heat up the entire kitchen or slave away over a hot burner? No sweat – the Hamilton Beach Countertop Oven provides extra capacity for second oven convenience as well as four ways to cook: BAKE, CONVECTION, BROIL and ROTISSERIE.

A 9"x13" baking pan can be found in most kitchens in North America, used for making everything from lasagna to brownies. Not only does this oven fit two 9"x13" pans at once, unlike conventional ovens without convection technology, the Countertop Oven with Convection and Rotisserie comes fully equipped. Instead of having heat come from just one central area and no fan to "stir-up" or circulate air evenly all over, this oven's convection technology utilizes a top and bottom heating element and a built-in fan to distribute heat evenly for a uniform temperature. That way, bakers can choose between traditional baking – ideal for cupcakes, cakes and soft baked goods – or convection baking – ideal for a crispy pizzas, cookies or even taquitos. Use the rotisserie feature for roasted chicken, beef roast or pork roast. Note: Only upper heating elements will be on during the rotisserie mode.

TIPS & CARE
Before cooking with the oven, always PREHEAT for approximately 5 minutes. Check pan manufacturer's directions for oven-safe rating. Do not cover the crumb/drip tray or any part of the oven in aluminum foil (causes overheating); however, use of aluminum foil to partially cover casseroles or some foods is acceptable. Visit foodsafety. gov for more safe cooking temperature information.

The full-width crumb/drip tray slides out from the front, allowing easy washing. For the best oven performance, cleaning should be done regularly. Unplug first and allow oven to cool before interior and exterior cleaning. For interior cleaning: wipe oven walls, bottom tray and glass door with a damp, soapy cloth, but do not scratch or damage heating element tube. Repeat with a damp, clean cloth. All removable parts should be hand washed in warm, soapy water as well. For stubborn interior stains, use a plastic scouring pad. For exterior cleaning: wipe oven walls with a damp cloth, but do not use abrasive cleansers or metal scouring pads; this can scrape/scratch the surface.

cpsc_product_name: Early Learning Centre Little Senses Lights & Sounds Shape Sorter Toys
incident_product_description:
Learning Resources

Model LER6711

Website Description: These fun owl friends flew over the rainbow! Introduce toddlers to early color, shape, and number skills with the Snap-n-Learn Rainbow Owls from Learning Resources. This set of 10 friendly two-piece owl toys comes in 10 vivid shades drawn from all the colors of the rainbow - learn rosy red, vivid violet, and every shade in between! Sized just right for little hands, each manipulative owl pulls apart and snaps together easily, and encourages mix-and-match play while building fine motor skills with every snap! In addition to color matching, the owls also help kids build shape recognition and early STEM skills. Sort the owls by warm and cool colors, arrange them in numerical order for a quick math lesson, or practice shape recognition with the colorful figures printed on each owl's tummy - these owls are color toys, number toys, and sorting toys all in one! Snap-n-Learn Rainbow Owls wipe clean with a damp cloth, and come with a reusable plastic bucket for simple pick-up and storage.

Model illu-Mist 40001 one-gallon & 40002 two-gallon batt

This recall involves illu-Mist 40001 one-gallon & 40002 two-gallon battery-powered garden sprayers.  The sprayers have a plastic triangle-shaped handle in gray with teal blue trim and a white tank with “illu-Mist” printed on the front side of the tank.  The sprayers measure 15.5 inches and 19.5 inches in height when assembled.  
 
Remedy:
Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled battery-powered sprayers, remove the battery tray, and look for a brown battery.  If the battery is brown, consumers should remove the battery and tray and dispose of them in accordance with local laws for disposal of lithium-ion batteries, and contact HD Hudson for a free replacement battery and tray.  Always follow proper battery use and storage procedures as listed in the instructions.
Incidents/Injuries:
The firm has received four reports of batteries overheating, including one report of a battery melting and catching fire resulting in less than $100 in property damage.

1) Leak from toaster heats knobs which get as hot as inside of toaster. Steam visible on knobs while heating.
2) Door does not open completely, so easily tips forward toward user and worse hot rack slides out toward user when tips.
3) Poor or zero tactile and audio feedback for off, and hard to turn-off.
4) Worse, just passed the off position is a permanently on position. So easy to accidentally keep on. Fire hazard. They even know it, and warn in big letters what to do in case of fire. Only indicator is subtle light, and very subtle in daytime since it dims (not kidding) when inside reaches set temperature.
5) Small, but BPA containing product poorly labeled.
6) Rack is in contact with glass. I could not maintain any space, even with effort. This is probably why negative reviewers report that glass shatters.

The main risk is obviously that heat leaks through backs of knobs to a a virtually unlimited temperature (maybe limit is 450 degrees F, I did not do an experiment) AND easily tips toward user spilling hot rack, and falling.

incident_product_description:
LG LRMXC2206S French Door Refrigerator/Freezer  Stainless Steel,  Counter Depth     34-3/4" Wide, 31-1/4" Depth, and 69-3/4" High

We purchased an LG LRMXC2206S in April, 2022, and once installed, we placed digital thermometers in the fridge and also in the freezer to monitor the internal temps.  After a few days to equilibrate, the internal fridge temperatures recorded by the thermometer was 3-4 degrees F higher than the set temperature on the door control panel.  We called LG service about this and their tech came, took some temperature measurements and then explained that everything was fine since "the actual temperature inside the unit can be within 5 to 10 degrees of the set temperature" (We got the same reply when contacting LG service online and by phone).  We lived with a lower setting (34F) to maintain an internal temp of 37F.  In late April of 2023, we found that the internal temps were on the rise despite lowering the control temp to its lowest setting of 33F.  We were getting internal temps of 40-41F (with the control temp set to 33F), which is pushing against the max temp for safe food storage in fridges recommended by the US FDA.   Since the one-year warranty had expired three weeks earlier, we called a service person who replaced a fan, the back panel containing a thermistor, and finally the main control board.  All this took 4 months and cost us roughly $800.  When all the servicing was complete, we still had to set the control panel temp to the minimum setting (33F) to maintain a safe internal temperature of 37-38F.  As a result, we perceive a potential danger to others because of the inability of the LG LRMXC2206S to maintain temperatures that are safe for food storage as defined by the US FDA.  Please note that the freezer worked well throughout.

incident_product_description:
LG LRMXC2206S French Door Refrigerator/Freezer  Stainless Steel,  Counter Depth     34-3/4" Wide, 31-1/4" Depth, and 69-3/4" High

We purchased an LG LRMXC2206S in April, 2022, and once installed, we placed digital thermometers in the fridge and also in the freezer to monitor the internal temps.  After a few days to equilibrate, the internal fridge temperatures recorded by the thermometer was 3-4 degrees F higher than the set temperature on the door control panel.  We called LG service about this and their tech came, took some temperature measurements and then explained that everything was fine since "the actual temperature inside the unit can be within 5 to 10 degrees of the set temperature" (We got the same reply when contacting LG service online and by phone).  We lived with a lower setting (34F) to maintain an internal temp of 37F.  In late April of 2023, we found that the internal temps were on the rise despite lowering the control temp to its lowest setting of 33F.  We were getting internal temps of 40-41F (with the control temp set to 33F), which is pushing against the max temp for safe food storage in fridges recommended by the US FDA.   Since the one-year warranty had expired three weeks earlier, we called a service person who replaced a fan, the back panel containing a thermistor, and finally the main control board.  All this took 4 months and cost us roughly $800.  When all the servicing was complete, we still had to set the control panel temp to the minimum setting (33F) to maintain a safe internal temperature of 37-38F.  As a result, we perceive a potential danger to others because of the inability of the LG LRMXC2206S to maintain temperatures that are safe for food storage as defined by the US FDA.  Please note that the freezer worked well throughout.

From Amazon:
Hamilton Beach 31103A Countertop Oven with Convection and Rotisserie, Metallic
Maximum versatility - including rotisserie
Extra-large capacity - fits two 12" pizzas, two 9" x 13" casseroles, or two cake pansThis oven is 110 voltage only It is packaged in SIOC packaging to avoid damage in shipping
Revolving rotisserie - meat self-bastes as it turns - fits a 5 lb chicken
Convection setting bakes faster and more evenly than traditional oven;Bake & broil settings with 2 hour timer1311 H x 2062 W x 1654 D

Hamilton Beach Countertop Oven with Convection & Rotisserie 31103
Small enough to fit on your kitchen counter, but large enough to help you prepare for any meal or party, the Hamilton Beach Countertop Oven with Convection & Rotisserie boasts full-size oven performance in compact, energy-efficient form.Designed with both kitchen style and practicality in mind, the Countertop Oven with Convection & Rotisserie is portable and countertop convenient. It's packed with versatile cooking options that range from baking cakes to crisping cookies to broiling salmon to roasting an entire 5 lb. chicken, roast or pork. There's no need to spend extra time cooking separate meals for the pickier ones, either. The wide interior and adjustable cooking racks provide double the space for cooking multiple foods at once.What's more, this oven is ideal for anyone, anywhere and anytime. It can replace the microwave in your office, offer easy cooking access for the elderly, serve as a staple for apartment dwellers or provide snack enthusiasts with a little added treat.


PRODUCT FEATURE BENEFITS
Uses 49% less energy than a typical kitchen oven
Extra-large capacity accommodates two 12" pizzas, two 9"x13" casseroles, two cake pans, two sheets of cookies or a 5 lb. chicken
Easy-clean, nonstick oven interior
Includes two oven racks, large enamel-coated baking pan, small baking pan and broil rack
Broil rack also stacks directly on small baking pan for roasting meats
Includes rotisserie accessories: rotisserie lift and forks with rod (skewer) Slide-out, full-width crumb/drip tray
Easy-to-read temperature dial on front control panel can be adjusted to desired or pre-set temperatures
Easy-to-read function dial on front control panel can be adjusted to four pre-programmed settings: BAKE, CONVECTION, BROIL, ROTISSERIE
Power indicator light
2-hour cooking timer with audible tone and automatic shutoff

Gives You the Choice of Bake, Convection, Broil or Rotisserie
Don't want to heat up the entire kitchen or slave away over a hot burner? No sweat – the Hamilton Beach Countertop Oven provides extra capacity for second oven convenience as well as four ways to cook: BAKE, CONVECTION, BROIL and ROTISSERIE.

A 9"x13" baking pan can be found in most kitchens in North America, used for making everything from lasagna to brownies. Not only does this oven fit two 9"x13" pans at once, unlike conventional ovens without convection technology, the Countertop Oven with Convection and Rotisserie comes fully equipped. Instead of having heat come from just one central area and no fan to "stir-up" or circulate air evenly all over, this oven's convection technology utilizes a top and bottom heating element and a built-in fan to distribute heat evenly for a uniform temperature. That way, bakers can choose between traditional baking – ideal for cupcakes, cakes and soft baked goods – or convection baking – ideal for a crispy pizzas, cookies or even taquitos. Use the rotisserie feature for roasted chicken, beef roast or pork roast. Note: Only upper heating elements will be on during the rotisserie mode.

TIPS & CARE
Before cooking with the oven, always PREHEAT for approximately 5 minutes. Check pan manufacturer's directions for oven-safe rating. Do not cover the crumb/drip tray or any part of the oven in aluminum foil (causes overheating); however, use of aluminum foil to partially cover casseroles or some foods is acceptable. Visit foodsafety. gov for more safe cooking temperature information.

The full-width crumb/drip tray slides out from the front, allowing easy washing. For the best oven performance, cleaning should be done regularly. Unplug first and allow oven to cool before interior and exterior cleaning. For interior cleaning: wipe oven walls, bottom tray and glass door with a damp, soapy cloth, but do not scratch or damage heating element tube. Repeat with a damp, clean cloth. All removable parts should be hand washed in warm, soapy water as well. For stubborn interior stains, use a plastic scouring pad. For exterior cleaning: wipe oven walls with a damp cloth, but do not use abrasive cleansers or metal scouring pads; this can scrape/scratch the surface.

incident_product_description: The product is a pvc framed double hung window installed in a newer home.  Similar incidents have occurred on other windows in my home.  The defect appears to be screws that hold the balance mechanism to the frame are too small and the force of the heavy springs pull them out of the plastic frame.  See photo.  The manufacturer replaces the broken mechanisms under warranty but provides the same undersized screws with the replacement parts and they are not acceptable. This is a complicated issue that most homeowners would be unable to diagnose and should require appropriate warnings and/or replacement of screws to the proper size.  The sash is extremely heavy and could cause injury.

incident_product_description:
LG LRMXC2206S French Door Refrigerator/Freezer  Stainless Steel,  Counter Depth     34-3/4" Wide, 31-1/4" Depth, and 69-3/4" High

We purchased an LG LRMXC2206S in April, 2022, and once installed, we placed digital thermometers in the fridge and also in the freezer to monitor the internal temps.  After a few days to equilibrate, the internal fridge temperatures recorded by the thermometer was 3-4 degrees F higher than the set temperature on the door control panel.  We called LG service about this and their tech came, took some temperature measurements and then explained that everything was fine since "the actual temperature inside the unit can be within 5 to 10 degrees of the set temperature" (We got the same reply when contacting LG service online and by phone).  We lived with a lower setting (34F) to maintain an internal temp of 37F.  In late April of 2023, we found that the internal temps were on the rise despite lowering the control temp to its lowest setting of 33F.  We were getting internal temps of 40-41F (with the control temp set to 33F), which is pushing against the max temp for safe food storage in fridges recommended by the US FDA.   Since the one-year warranty had expired three weeks earlier, we called a service person who replaced a fan, the back panel containing a thermistor, and finally the main control board.  All this took 4 months and cost us roughly $800.  When all the servicing was complete, we still had to set the control panel temp to the minimum setting (33F) to maintain a safe internal temperature of 37-38F.  As a result, we perceive a potential danger to others because of the inability of the LG LRMXC2206S to maintain temperatures that are safe for food storage as defined by the US FDA.  Please note that the freezer worked well throughout.

I am also reporting this product to the Consumer Product Safety Commission in hopes that these lights are removed from the market to prevent fire damage (or death) to other purchaser's properties.
 
Please take immediate action on this defective solar light before it causes irreparable damage to humans, property, or other living things.

Hazard: The hose of the gas tank can get too close to the firebox and be exposed to heat, posing a fire hazard to consumers.

Incidents/Injuries: Fiesta has received 161 reports of grill fires, resulting in nine injuries, including two incidents of major burns on different parts of the body, six incidents of minor burns, and an incident involving temporary hearing loss.

Description: This recall involves Blue Ember liquid propane (LP) outdoor grills with model and serial numbers listed below. The cabinet style grill has two doors and is silver and black or silver and gray. "Blue Ember" is printed on the grill’s hood. The model and serial numbers are printed on a rating plate label on the rear of the grill. The rating plate label was destroyed in the fire/explosion.  The model number was provided by the home owner.

From Amazon:
Hamilton Beach 31103A Countertop Oven with Convection and Rotisserie, Metallic
Maximum versatility - including rotisserie
Extra-large capacity - fits two 12" pizzas, two 9" x 13" casseroles, or two cake pansThis oven is 110 voltage only It is packaged in SIOC packaging to avoid damage in shipping
Revolving rotisserie - meat self-bastes as it turns - fits a 5 lb chicken
Convection setting bakes faster and more evenly than traditional oven;Bake & broil settings with 2 hour timer1311 H x 2062 W x 1654 D
Durable stainless steel construction
Hamilton Beach Countertop Oven with Convection & Rotisserie 31103
Small enough to fit on your kitchen counter, but large enough to help you prepare for any meal or party, the Hamilton Beach Countertop Oven with Convection & Rotisserie boasts full-size oven performance in compact, energy-efficient form.Designed with both kitchen style and practicality in mind, the Countertop Oven with Convection & Rotisserie is portable and countertop convenient. It's packed with versatile cooking options that range from baking cakes to crisping cookies to broiling salmon to roasting an entire 5 lb. chicken, roast or pork. There's no need to spend extra time cooking separate meals for the pickier ones, either. The wide interior and adjustable cooking racks provide double the space for cooking multiple foods at once.What's more, this oven is ideal for anyone, anywhere and anytime. It can replace the microwave in your office, offer easy cooking access for the elderly, serve as a staple for apartment dwellers or provide snack enthusiasts with a little added treat.


PRODUCT FEATURE BENEFITS
Uses 49% less energy than a typical kitchen oven
Extra-large capacity accommodates two 12" pizzas, two 9"x13" casseroles, two cake pans, two sheets of cookies or a 5 lb. chicken
Easy-clean, nonstick oven interior
Includes two oven racks, large enamel-coated baking pan, small baking pan and broil rack
Broil rack also stacks directly on small baking pan for roasting meats
Includes rotisserie accessories: rotisserie lift and forks with rod (skewer) Slide-out, full-width crumb/drip tray
Easy-to-read temperature dial on front control panel can be adjusted to desired or pre-set temperatures
Easy-to-read function dial on front control panel can be adjusted to four pre-programmed settings: BAKE, CONVECTION, BROIL, ROTISSERIE
Power indicator light
2-hour cooking timer with audible tone and automatic shutoff

Gives You the Choice of Bake, Convection, Broil or Rotisserie
Don't want to heat up the entire kitchen or slave away over a hot burner? No sweat – the Hamilton Beach Countertop Oven provides extra capacity for second oven convenience as well as four ways to cook: BAKE, CONVECTION, BROIL and ROTISSERIE.

A 9"x13" baking pan can be found in most kitchens in North America, used for making everything from lasagna to brownies. Not only does this oven fit two 9"x13" pans at once, unlike conventional ovens without convection technology, the Countertop Oven with Convection and Rotisserie comes fully equipped. Instead of having heat come from just one central area and no fan to "stir-up" or circulate air evenly all over, this oven's convection technology utilizes a top and bottom heating element and a built-in fan to distribute heat evenly for a uniform temperature. That way, bakers can choose between traditional baking – ideal for cupcakes, cakes and soft baked goods – or convection baking – ideal for a crispy pizzas, cookies or even taquitos. Use the rotisserie feature for roasted chicken, beef roast or pork roast. Note: Only upper heating elements will be on during the rotisserie mode.

TIPS & CARE
Before cooking with the oven, always PREHEAT for approximately 5 minutes. Check pan manufacturer's directions for oven-safe rating. Do not cover the crumb/drip tray or any part of the oven in aluminum foil (causes overheating); however, use of aluminum foil to partially cover casseroles or some foods is acceptable. Visit foodsafety. gov for more safe cooking temperature information.

The full-width crumb/drip tray slides out from the front, allowing easy washing. For the best oven performance, cleaning should be done regularly. Unplug first and allow oven to cool before interior and exterior cleaning. For interior cleaning: wipe oven walls, bottom tray and glass door with a damp, soapy cloth, but do not scratch or damage heating element tube. Repeat with a damp, clean cloth. All removable parts should be hand washed in warm, soapy water as well. For stubborn interior stains, use a plastic scouring pad. For exterior cleaning: wipe oven walls with a damp cloth, but do not use abrasive cleansers or metal scouring pads; this can scrape/scratch the surface.
